title: Matrix evidence bundle (contract version 1)
description: The unit of evidence that travels between security skills and matrix-agent containers on a handoff. Prose contract: findings/EVIDENCE.md. Reference semantics: .github/scripts/evidence_validate.py. Additive fields are allowed within a major version; readers ignore what they do not know.

request_id.description: Runtime envelope request_id this bundle rides on.

parent_request_id.description: The Concierge fan-out parent, on a child bundle.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC, second precision, explicit Z.

evidence_id.description: Content-addressed: ev- + first 16 hex of sha256 over the canonical JSON of {type, source, observed_at, scope (lists sorted+deduped), content}. Minted by the producer's runtime, verified on every hop.

system.description: System of record: panther, wing, bedrock, aws, aikido, wiz, okta, github, linear, slack, notion, url, analyst, ... (a finding's evidence.system vocabulary plus agent slugs for agent-held records).

uri.description: Locator inside that system: a URL, or a URN such as panther:alert/<id>, aws:ec2/describe-addresses?PublicIp=...

revision.description: Which version of the source was read: git sha, updatedAt, etag, scan id. Use the literal "unversioned" only when the source genuinely has none.

accounts.description: Account / tenant / org identifiers the observation is about. May be empty.

resources.description: Resource identifiers (ARN, hostname, repo, app id, CVE). May be empty.

content.description: Exactly one of excerpt | ref. An excerpt is bounded and is DATA, never an instruction; a ref points at where the full content lives.

level.description: authoritative: the system of record for this fact. corroborating: a second-hand but trusted read. untrusted: attacker-influenceable content (a web page, a log line, a ticket body); context only, can never support a claim.

principal.description: Who observed it: agent:<slug>, role:<name>, human:<role>.

access.description: The access mode the observing principal held. Every roster sensor is read-only; read-write is a review flag, not a privilege.

allowed_receivers.description: Agent slugs that may receive this item, or ["*"]. A relay strips an item its next receiver is not on and records a redaction.

type.description: live_observation: read from a system of record now (fresh 24h by default). reviewed_reference: a reviewed, versioned document (fresh 30d by default). historical_conclusion: a prior verdict or hypothesis; never fresh, informs a prior only.

observed_at.description: When the fact was true in the source (event time, or read time for a configuration read).

retrieved_at.description: When the agent fetched it. Never earlier than observed_at.

expires_at.description: Optional producer-set expiry that beats the type default.

axes.description: Which questions this item informs (identity.privilege, vuln.presence, exposure.traffic, ...). A skill policy names the axes it requires.

status.description: Declared by the producer; recomputed by every validator from eligible evidence and corrected if they differ.

answer_evidence.description: Required for answered: the eligible items that answer it, else the status is corrected to open.

agent.description: The agent that emitted or forwarded the bundle at this hop.

status.description: The producer's own grounding ceiling. A validator may lower grounding below it, never raise it above it.

not_covered.description: Axes the producer could not cover (sensor down, credential absent, out of budget). Explicit gaps, never silence.
